desc: Derive necessary and sufficient conditions for feasibility given a fixed common sum \(S\), including how unknown A/B entries can be assigned.
Reformulate fixed-\(S\) feasibility as a matching/counting problem.
Determine candidate common sums and prove the required bounds.
Check edge cases involving unknowns, fixed values exceeding \(S\), and duplicates.
Produce and validate an \(O(U_AU_B)\) Python implementation; public samples passed.
